records.claim: Russia extended the export ban for diesel, marine fuel and gas oils shipped by direct producers through September 30, 2026.
records.title: Russia extends ban on diesel exports until September 30
records.boundary: Policy fact only; does not itself prove a new market-price move.

records.claim: Russia said the extension was intended to stabilize the domestic fuel market, with several refineries still offline after repeated attacks.
records.title: Russia extends ban on diesel exports until September 30
records.boundary: Refinery-offline context is reported background; exact current capacity loss is not asserted.

records.claim: Iran's president said foreign trade had fallen nearly 35% because of U.S. sanctions and a naval blockade of Iranian ports.
records.title: War weighs on Iran's economy as US intensifies sanctions
records.boundary: Attributed official statement; not independently audited trade statistics.

records.claim: Iran continued to assert control over the Strait of Hormuz while also signaling interest in reviving the June interim understanding and pursuing diplomacy.
records.title: War weighs on Iran's economy as US intensifies sanctions
records.boundary: Does not establish actual vessel-flow improvement or a signed navigation agreement.

records.claim: Chevron was reported to be close to finalizing migration of its Venezuelan joint ventures into a new framework that would allow greater operating control and oilfield expansion.
records.title: Chevron to complete deal in Venezuela to migrate, expand oil projects, sources say
records.boundary: Source-based negotiation report; formal signing and implementation remained pending.

records.claim: The contemplated Chevron arrangement included Petropiar expansion toward the neighboring Ayacucho 8 block and additional Orinoco-area expansion discussions.
records.title: Chevron to complete deal in Venezuela to migrate, expand oil projects, sources say
records.boundary: No incremental production volume is treated as realized.

records.claim: No new in-window benchmark settlement or assessed-price evidence meeting ReportOps price semantics was used for Brent/WTI, JKM, TTF or China LNG/LPG; the price section is therefore marked DATA_GAP.
records.title: Weekend fixed-window price evidence gap
records.boundary: Absence claim is limited to evidence accepted in this run; it is not a claim that no market quotes existed anywhere.
